title: HardTech-___
intro:
Registry index for the HardTech repo family (formerly DeepSc-___) - same model as `CG-___`, `Projects-___` and `cloud-___`. This repo is an INDEX, not a container: it holds `repos.json` (the registry, a subset of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json), `clone.sh` (pick which repos to have locally) and one committed relative symlink per member (`<member> -> ../<member>`); the actual clones live as siblings in `~/git/`.

Top-level hub since #1291 (it was under `Projects-___`).
